translation: By the sky with the constellations
And by the Promised Day
And by the witness and the witnessed
Destroyed were the People of the Trench
The fire supplied with fuel
While they sat around it

arabic: وَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفۡعَلُونَ بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ شُهُودٞ
translation: And were witnessing what they did to the believers

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
translation: They begrudged them only because they believed in God the Almighty, the Praiseworthy

arabic: ٱلَّذِي لَهُۥ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ شَهِيدٌ
translation: To Whom belongs the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. God is witness over everything

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُواْ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ وَٱلۡمُؤۡمِنَٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمۡ يَتُوبُواْ فَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابُ ٱلۡحَرِيقِ
translation: Those who tempt the believers, men and women, then do not repent; for them is the punishment of Hell; for them is the punishment of Burning

arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٞ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡكَبِيرُ
translation: Those who believe and do righteous deeds will have Gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great triumph
The onslaught of your Lord is severe
It is He who begins and repeats
And He is the Forgiving, the Loving
Possessor of the Glorious Throne
Doer of whatever He wills
Has there come to you the story of the legions
Of Pharaoh and Thamood
In fact, those who disbelieve are in denial
And God encloses them from beyond
In fact, it is a Glorious Quran
In a Preserved Tablet
